title.value: Descent-Net: Learning Descent Directions for Constrained Optimization

abstract.value: Deep learning approaches, known for their ability to model complex relationships and fast execution, are increasingly being applied to solve large optimization problems. However, existing methods often face challenges in simultaneously ensuring feasibility and achieving an optimal objective value. To address this issue, we propose Descent-Net, a neural network designed to learn an effective descent direction from a feasible solution. By updating the solution along this learned direction, Descent-Net improves the objective value while preserving feasibility. Our method demonstrates strong performance on both synthetic optimization tasks and the real-world AC optimal power flow problem.
